description: A department director must finalize whether an employee completes probation successfully and set the employee's first post-probation assignment and review process.

shared_context.S1: Rina is nearing the end of a six-month probationary period on the customer-success team.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final probation decision and records the post-probation development plan.
shared_context.S3: Rina's current review packet describes her as dependable in routine work but gives no documented count of customer-escalation observations.
shared_context.S4: The department's routine probation review includes a check-in with the employee and at least one colleague before the director records the final outcome.

PF1.text: Marcus personally observed Rina successfully de-escalate exactly three difficult customer cases during the last two months; he kept the examples in personal notes but did not submit them to the review packet.

PF2.text: Rina's hiring manager informally promised that, if she completed probation, she would serve as the onboarding buddy for the next new hire for exactly six weeks; the manager left the department before adding that assignment to the review plan.

PF3.text: Rina has a documented reading-processing accommodation from the recruiting process requiring written scenario prompts at least two business days before any live role-play assessment; the accommodation is not included in the current probation packet.

acceptance_conditions: Rina must be confirmed as having completed probation.
The review record must document exactly three successful customer-escalation observations.
Rina must be assigned as onboarding buddy for the next new hire for exactly six weeks.
Any live role-play assessment must provide written scenario prompts at least two business days in advance.
A six-week onboarding-buddy assignment commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'onboarding_buddy_assignment' and c['target'] == 'Rina' and c['detail'] == 'six weeks' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The three firsthand successful de-escalations change the documented evidence count from no specified observations to exactly 3 and provide the basis for confirming Rina's probation.
The hiring manager's promise changes the post-probation assignment to onboarding buddy for exactly six weeks and requires the corresponding commitment.
The accommodation changes the role-play process from an unspecified notice period to written prompts delivered at least 2 business days in advance.
